page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening) with a running head at top; main text in one column; a narrow column of marginal notes at the left edge of the scan belonging to the facing page, which is cut off and not transcribed here.

main_text.p: Generale vt ex æquali ratione iucundè iter se vi-uant. 1.Pet.3.8.
Speciale, vt honore alij alijs præeant. Eph.5.21.
Inæqualium erga inæquales est pro inæqualitatis ratione debita officia præstare. Eph. 5. 22. 23. & Rom.13.7.
Sunt autem vtraq; {prima, quæ ex primis fluunt.} 1.Tim 5.4. Iob.32.6.
Prima sunt, quæ ex ætatis & propinquitatis differentia, originem traxerunt. Gen.13.8. cum 14.14.
Hinc salutationes speciales ex speciali & sancto amore profectæ vt quæ fit in φιλήμαλι ἀγαπῶνς. 1.Pet.5.14.Gen.29.10.11. Exod.18.7.
In ætate æquale officium est vt pro æqualitatis ratione in ijsdem studijs, exercitijs, obleƈtamentis, sanctè sobriè & iucundè se gerant. 1.Cor.13,11. cum Tit.2.3.4.5.6.
main_text.l: sunt Seniorum erga iuniores. Iob.32.6. Leuit.
main_text.p: Seniorum erga iuniores officium est, vt coram ipsis Dei diuinæ æternitatis imaginem ferant. Leuit.19.32.cum Pro.16.31.Pro.20.29.
Primum vt in omnibus sanctitatis partibus e-is præluceant.ibid.
Secundum, est grauitas, quæ facilem & ætati conuenientem dignitatem, in totius erga iuniores

page.notes: Left-margin fragments (e.g. "ia é", "nesta", "gnis,", "Hinc", "bona", "liase", "rale") belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Greek in the line "amore profectæ" is transcribed as printed but may contain errors. Marginal references to Gen. and Tit. appear in the running text as printed. The catchword "ores" is shown at the foot of the last line; it is a catchword, not text.
